subject: general
question: The Brihadisvara temple is in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Brihadisvara temple is located in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu.
 
• It was built by the Chola emperor Raja Raja Chola I between 1003 and 1010 AD.
 
• The temple is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site known as the "Great Living Chola Temples".
 
• The temple is a fine example of Dravidian architecture and is renowned for its massive tower (Vimana), which stands at about 66 meters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dravidian Architecture:**

 
 
• This architectural style originated in Southern India and is characterized by its pyramid-shaped towers called Vimanams.
 
• The structures typically include large gopurams (gateway towers), pillared halls, and intricately carved stone sculptures.
 
• Dravidian architecture is also known for its use of granite, which is locally available in Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• **Chola Dynasty:**
 
 
• The Chola dynasty was one of the longest-ruling dynasties in the history of Southern India, with significant contributions to Indian art, architecture, and culture.
 
• The Cholas are known for their military prowess and naval dominance.
 
• They ruled over parts of Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, and Andhra Pradesh, and even extended their influence to Southeast Asia.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Sites:**
 
 
• The Great Living Chola Temples include the Brihadisvara Temple at Thanjavur, the Brihadisvara Temple at Gangaikonda Cholapuram, and the Airavatesvara Temple at Darasuram.
 
• These temples are recognized for their architectural brilliance, intricate sculptures, and historical significance.
 
• Being part of the UNESCO World Heritage list ensures that these sites are protected and preserved for future generations.
 
 
 
• **Raja Raja Chola I:**
 
 
• He was one of the greatest rulers of the Chola dynasty and is credited with establishing a strong administrative system.
 
• His reign marked the peak of Chola power, with extensive military conquests and cultural development.
 
• Under his rule, the Chola dynasty saw significant advancements in art, architecture, and literature.
